articles.title: Berkshire buys more Lennar shares, but pace of purchases slows
articles.summary: In an SEC filing late Wednesday, Berkshire disclosed it bought a total of $53.6 million of Lennar's Class A shares and another $329,000 of the super-voting B shares on Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday. That puts the position at a total of 26.6 million shares valued at $2.1 billion based on Friday's closing prices.

articles.title: Cerebras stock hits post-IPO low, tumbling 20% for the week on Nvidia pressure and lockup expiration
articles.summary: Cerebras stock plummeted nearly 20% this week to its lowest price since the company's monster IPO in May, after a report that chip giant Nvidia will power a crucial piece of OpenAI's latest model. The stock, which closed on Friday at $166.43, was also under pressure this week due to the expiration of post-IPO restrictions on some insider shares. Investors were excited by the prospect of an alternative to Nvidia to power AI.

articles.title: 10-year Treasury yield ticks higher despite weaker-than-expected jobs report
articles.summary: The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield rose almost 5 basis points to 5.281%. Earlier this week, the yield reached its highest levels since 2002. The recent rise in yields reflects concerns about stubborn inflation and hawkish central bank commentary, fueling expectations that interest rates could remain elevated for longer.

articles.title: 1.7 million skilled trade jobs will open annually through 2035, report says—experts don't know who will fill them
articles.summary: Skilled trade workers are already in high demand, and researchers say the industry will continue to see steady job growth in the decade to come. The State of America's Skilled Trades report, published Wednesday, found that 1.7 million skilled trade jobs will open each year through 2035.
